sections.content_text: Section 95 - Collection of Tax from Travel Agent (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other provision of this Act, any person responsible for making payment to a resident, by way of commission or rebate or any other benefit, however name called, shall, at the time of payment of such sum, shall deduct tax or collect advance tax at the rate of 0.3% (zero point three percent) on the total amount convertible by sale of passenger tickets or for carrying of goods by cargo aircraft- (2) Mentioned in sub-section (1), if any amount in excess of incentive bonus, performance bonus or any other benefit, by whatever name called, is paid by way of sale of tickets or carrying of goods by air, the person responsible for payment of such amount at the time of payment, shall deduct an amount equal to a/ b x c , where— “a” = incentive bonus, performance bonus or any other benefit mentioned in this sub-section, “b” = the amount of commission discount or any other benefit mentioned in sub-section (1), and “c” = amount of tax at source on commission or deduction or any other benefit mentioned in sub- section (1). (3) In calculating the price of the ticket or charge, any money paid or charge for any origination fee, travel tax, flight safety insurance, security tax and airport tax shall not be included.
